instructions: The night before, or at least 12 hours ahead: drain all three cans of beans well and rinse the kidney beans. Transfer the beans to a large heatproof bowl.
Thinly slice half the green pepper, slice 1/2 cup of the onion, and dice 1/2 cup of celery. Add them to the beans.
In a small saucepan, combine the sugar, vinegar, oil, salt, celery seed and pepper. Heat over medium until the sugar dissolves and the dressing is hot.
Pour the hot dressing over the beans and vegetables and toss to coat.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, stirring or shaking the container a few times. It keeps in the fridge for up to 5 days.
To serve, stir it once more and spoon it out cold.
advance_prep_notes: make it the night before, chill at least 12 hours
method_notes: Spend With Pennies (4.99 from 54 ratings) combines canned green, yellow and kidney beans with pepper, onion and celery, pours over a hot sugar, vinegar and oil dressing, and chills it overnight. Here the optional lima beans are left out and the dressing is scaled to three cans. Some other versions use chickpeas or cannellini instead, and a few add fresh herbs just before serving.
